2. The petitioner seeks regular bail in a case registered for the offence punishable under sections 406, 420, 467, 468, 120B of the Indian Penal Code .
3 . As per the prosecution case , this petitioner, in conspiracy with other accused persons, executed forged and fabricated sale deed in favour of co-accused Meena Devi without any right and title over 4 dhur land of informant.
Out of those three brothers, Uttim Sah died without any heir, Hiraman Sah had one son, namely, Devlal Sah, but said Devlal Sah died issueless.
, and it is evident from the FIR itself that informant has 2 Katha 18 dhur land and petitioner no. 1 has sold only 4 dhur of the total land, meaning thereby petitioner no. 1 has not sold land of informant, but rather he has sold his share of land.
Moreover, the present case relates to partition and is purely civil in nature and also no suit has been brought in existence for setting aside the alleged fraudulent sale deed,
as such, no criminal offence is made out against petitioner.
It is further submitted that co- accused persons having identical allegation have already been granted bail by this Hon'ble Court Cr. Misc. No. 54207 of 2024 vide order dated 03.09.2024 and Cr. Misc. No.
56641 of 2024 vide order dated 04.10.2024 .
